# Naturable

> Local privacy writing tool for blog, email, and marketing drafts.

Naturable is a browser-local natural writing editor for English and Simplified Chinese. It highlights mechanical AI-style patterns and helps writers revise in place. Free checking does not upload drafts to the cloud.

## Key URLs

- https://naturable.app/en/
- https://naturable.app/zh-cn/
- https://naturable.app/en/app/
- https://naturable.app/zh-cn/app/
- https://naturable.app/en/learn/
- https://naturable.app/zh-cn/learn/
- https://naturable.app/en/learn/remove-ai-writing-style/
- https://naturable.app/zh-cn/learn/remove-ai-writing-style/
- https://naturable.app/en/how-it-works/
- https://naturable.app/en/pricing/
- https://naturable.app/en/privacy/

## What it is / is not

- Is: on-device pattern checks for clearer blog, email, and marketing copy
- Is not: an AI-detector bypass product, a guaranteed humanizer, or a cloud rewrite service
